Codes are special words or phrases that players can enter into a designated text box to unlock rewards. Developers often release codes during events, updates, or promotions as a way to engage players and provide extra content.

To redeem a code in Obelisk Miner, go to the <code>{{Sprite|MenuButton|Menu|20x20|Menu}}</code> Button, then click on the <code>{{Sprite|Options_Button|Options|20x20|Options}}</code> Button , and click on <code>{{Sprite|EnterCodeButton||100x40|Enter Code}}</code>

All current codes are posted on the [https://discord.com/channels/496455472581312512/1308821214864736299 Discord server] or [https://reddit.com/r/IdleObeliskMiner subreddit]. Clicking the {{#fas:link}} icon next to the code will copy it to clipboard for easy copy-pasting.

== Reward Codes ==
Various codes will drop {{Sprite|Gift||16|Gifts}}, check the [[Gifts|dedicated article]] for information with regards to unlocks to see the most optimal times to open them.
Using (and saving) gifts in line with the unlocks on that page will ensure you get the most benefit from them.

== Misc. Codes ==

! colspan="2" | Misc codes
|-
| {{Code|CHAINBOMBABBREV}} || Toggled Chain Bomb Abbreviation (eg. 188034 to 188k) 
|-
| {{Code|CHOICEPARALYSIS}}, {{Code|MOREVP}} or {{Code|MOREVPS}} (since [[Update:V2.2.1]]) || Toggle to show the next 30 Value Packs in the Store
|-
| {{Code|FOUNDER}} (since [[Update:V1.9.11]]) || '''Requires [[Founder|Founder Pack]]''', Displays a block of text used to claim the founder role on the official Discord server. If you are not founder, the response is "Unable to find founder data" instead.
|-
| {{Code|FPS}} || Toggles an FPS counter 
|-
| {{Code|NAMEREROLLS}} || Shows the number of rerolls you have already made 
|-
| {{Code|OB}} || Shows Obelisk Art (that you have already defeated)
|-
| {{Code|UNASSIGNALLARCH}} || Unassigns all skill points in [[Archaeology]]
|-
| <div id="exportStats"></div>{{Code|EXPORTSTATS}} (since [[Update:V2.1.5]]) || Copies your stats into your clipboard in JSON form. Since [[Update:V2.2.20]] there is also a button at the botton of the [[Stats]] menu for this.
|-
! colspan="2" | Legacy codes
|-
| {{Code|MOREVP}} or {{Code|SHOWVP}} (Before [[Update:V2.0]]) || Toggle to show the next 5 Value Packs in the Store 
|-
| {{Code|SAVER}} or {{Code|SV}} (Before [[Update:V1.8.8]]) || Beta for the battery saver UI It was replaced in [[Update:V1.8.88]] with an option in the settings.
|-
| {{Code|SHOWLOG}} (Before [[Update:V1.8.8]]) || Toggle to Show Logs. It was replaced in [[Update:V1.8.88]] with an option in the settings.
|-
| {{Code|TOGGLELOWSPEED}} (Before [[Update:V2.1]])|| Toggle Game Speed max of 1. (Note that the 2x game speed buff duration will still decrease and that leaving this code on accidentally will sharply decrease your progress). It was removed in [[Update:V2.1.1]]
|-
|-

|-

| '''Pay {{Gems|50}}''' to gain 10 name reroll chances
|-

| '''Pay {{Gems|500}}''' to get 100 name reroll chances

== Trivia ==
* Trying to input an invalid code will result in the message "Invalid entry".
* Trying to input a code twice will result in messages such as, "Sorry, no double dipping," "Nice try noob," "Nice try ;)" "-1000 runecraft xp," "world 5 delayed +1 week," "Luck stat -1%", and the whole lyrics to "How you remind me" by Nickelback.
